summary_md: **Oai Chu ([@oaichu95](https://x.com/oaichu95/status/2115752723757089182))** rounds up four recent open repos that turn AI video into 3D assets: **anymove** (creature mocap from a clip), **video-to-texture** (UV textures), **video-to-blender** (Blender nodes) and **video-to-physics** (fixing clip physics) ([patch-gg/anymove](https://github.com/patch-gg/anymove)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - patch-gg/anymove: Motion capture for any creature from one AI video: two cameras in one frame, a DINOv2 joint reader, the rig fitted in both views, a GLB out.

relevance: AI video as an input to 3D asset pipelines.
